notes.title: Released Date & DEMO
notes.content: [h1]Release Date Announcement[/h1][p]I’m happy to share that [i]BARABIZNA[/i] will officially release on [b]October 23, 2025[/b]![/p][p]Check out the brand-new official trailer and get a glimpse of the nightmare that awaits.[/p][previewyoutube="NwRjmB9Bx1U;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Try the Demo Now [/h1][p]Step inside a decaying home where every room hides both what you need—and what you fear.[/p][list][*][p]Each item you collect draws you deeper into the nightmare, twisting the rules and making survival harder.[/p][/*][*][p]With just [b]15 minutes of battery life[/b] to light your way, every second matters.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][p]In the demo, you’ll face the first floor of the house, where you must find [b]3 random items[/b] to escape.[/p][/*][/list][p]Will you gather what you need and make it out alive… or will the house claim you?[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861550/BARABIZNA_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/b84d5ba1c9e7952278f208efb52b5028f2149f0d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo coming on September 18.
notes.content: [h1][b]Barabizna Demo is coming very soon.[/b][/h1][p]On [b]September 18[/b], the doors to the old house will finally open. In the [i]BARABIZNA[/i] demo, you’ll step into a decaying home where every room hides an object you need and something that doesn’t want you to find them.[/p][p]Each item you collect draws you deeper into the nightmare, twisting the rules and making survival harder with every step. With only 15 minutes of light to guide you, every second counts.[/p][p]Will you gather everything you need and escape… or will the house claim you?[/p][p][b]The demo arrives September 18 [/b]and until then, check out the [b]new teaser trailer[/b] for a glimpse of what awaits for you.[/p][previewyoutube="4hTx__eM_Tw;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Preperation for next fest 2025
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="UfNFcOZnVNk;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Steam Next Fest 2025[/h1][p]I am thrilled to share that BARABIZNA is getting ready to take part in Steam Next Fest 2025!

Expect new updates, fresh gameplay tweaks, and of course a short demo that will test your nerves. The barabizna is waiting for you…[/p][p]Along the way, [i]BARABIZNA[/i] has received a [b]visual overhaul[/b]. The old artwork just wasn’t quite right, so I have created [b]new, more interesting visuals[/b] that better capture the creepy, unsettling vibe of the game.[/p][h2]What’s Coming:[/h2][list][*][p] Playable Next Fest Demo[/p][/*][*][p] New scares a new mechanics[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] Sneak peeks into the creepy world of BARABIZNA[/p][/*][/list][p]
 Stay tuned, wishlist the game, and prepare to step into the unknown.  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3457800/BARABIZNA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: BARABIZNA is coming
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/29d7c7885fe1edd07f445289952fbe4d624b7df8.png"][/img][/p][h1]Can You Escape the BARABIZNA?[/h1][p]
Step into my first-ever project a short, spine-chilling horror game set in a creepy old house. Your mission: find and collect all the hidden items before it's too late. But beware... you're not alone.
[/p][previewyoutube="UfNFcOZnVNk;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]
🎮 Features:[/h2][p]
Every run offers a different set of items to collect. Find them all and escape with your car to survive.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/357004081b849dc5674aa0747197eb4f3a58edb0.gif"][/img]
Be careful with your battery—you only have 15 minutes of power. Once it’s gone, you’ll be alone in the dark.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/6fcea9b864c8745e02cc1d7c3aaa3cde927d5bda.gif"][/img]
Each item you collect makes the game more difficult, turning the search for the last few items into a true challenge.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445215/5af6c239e268737fdbf11ee5ffc9ce5e27398bb7.gif"][/img]
Do you have what it takes to escape? Try it now on my [url="https://cepela.itch.io/barabizna"]itch[/url] —if you dare! I am planning to release full version to steam this year. 

[/p]
